name: netrunner
description: Netrunner: a hacker theme for Claude Code. A status band above the prompt (usage bars, prompt cache WARM/COLD, a WAITING line and a sweep while anything runs) and four matching transcript skins: Packet Trace, Zero Day, Cold Boot and Black ICE.

variant.title: Color variant
variant.description: packet-trace: graphite, teal and violet. zero-day: terminal green and magenta. cold-boot: steel, ice cyan and periwinkle. black-ice: plum, hot magenta and electric purple.

skin.title: Transcript skin
skin.description: apply: switch the skins mod to the variant's skin when you pick a variant. keep: save the four Netrunner skins but leave your current skin alone.
